description: T-5265: references to a deleted sheet through a column delete left of their cell. S!C4:C7 hold 1,2,4,8; sheet F holds, in column A (it stays) and in column D (it moves left), rows 1-3: =SUM(S!C4:C7), =S!C4+1 and =SUM(S!$C$4:$C$7). delete_sheet S makes each a reference to a missing sheet; then delete_column B on F. Does a moved cell keep its text, shift its relative columns, or become a bare #REF!? Sheet Obs (never edited) holds, for F!A1, A2, A3, D1, D2 and D3 in turn, the value and the FORMULATEXT (A1:A12; the references to column D follow the moved cells).
